correctness.rationale: The rectangle law gives one freely chosen bit toward each other class for a type joining an old class and arbitrary orientations for a type in a fresh singleton class. In distinct old classes the representative rectangle forces the directed arc bit; no arc is possible in one old class, and the fresh types can always be put in distinct fresh classes, giving all-one rows and columns. Complementing a bit on one chosen side of each class pair normalizes representative directions. After retaining one fresh index, the integral Boolean differences kill rows and columns of degree at least two. The remaining pivot on the fresh entry 1 gives primitive relations p_j−2d_ji=0. Choosing a representative difference u_j for each j leaves the relations 2t_ji=0 and H_i=u_i+sum_j u_j=sum_{j≠i}s_ij t_ji; in particular the off-diagonal coefficient is −1 before rearranging, from 2(b_ij−1)+(1−2b_ij). For k≥3 the prescribed choices of representatives remove all torsion variables from row 1 and leave at least one private torsion variable in every other row. Eliminating one per such row leaves k²−3k+1 independent order-two variables and H_1=0, 2H_i=0 for i>1. Passing to u_i−u_1 and eliminating their sum gives k−2 more order-two variables and the cyclic factor 2(k+1). The active presentation is square of order k²+1 with finite cokernel, so the remaining nonzero factors are precisely 2k+1 units. The fresh and high-difference zero directions give the claimed nullity. For k=2 the active residual matrix I_2+J_2 has Smith factors 1,3; for k=1 a unimodular 2-by-2 block remains. These also give the stated characteristic ranks; ranks and positive factors depend only on k, while the number of zero factors also depends on n.
residual_risks: Finite exact Smith checks are corroboration, not the all-k proof. The argument classifies existential directed feasibility for a pair of realizations over a finite nonempty named base, not full two-type multiplicities or simultaneous feasibility.

value.rationale: This is a complete integral classification of a natural directed feasibility invariant for every finite named base in the semigeneric space. It explains the surprising collapse of an exponentially many-type presentation to k²+1 active dimensions, and detects the exact modular rank obstructions and exceptional small k that ordinary orbit counts or rational rank miss.
residual_risks: No classification of spectra, full two-types, or simultaneous realizations is claimed.
